text:
Ava Chen: Heads-up — quick sync on landing copy for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private. Need to finalize hero + CTA splits by EOD.
Ravi Patel: got it. Do we keep same hero for all 3 with subhead variants, or totally different approaches?
Maya Lopez: My vote: shared core message about 'predictable inference' then page-specific value props. keeps SEO consistent.
Tom Nguyen: agreed. For Hosted highlight 'fast time-to-value' + try API CTA, Dedicated should be 'predictable throughput' + contact sales CTA, Private should be 'data residency & control' + request demo.
Lena Brooks: for inbound routing, we need 3 funnels: self-serve signup, sales lead (dedicated), enterprise AE (private). Can we add microcopy on forms to route automatically?
Ava Chen: yes. Proposed microcopy: "Need guaranteed capacity? Contact sales" "Using regulated data? Request a private demo". Add hidden field 'lead_route' value to tag in HubSpot.
Ravi Patel: perfect. Also we should surface benchmark callouts on Hosted — e.g., '30% lower per-token cost vs baseline' (we'll confirm numbers). Put a 'Benchmarks' anchor that links to a detailed page.
Maya Lopez: for the hero lines drafts:
> Hosted: "Get models into production in minutes — fast hosted inference with predictable pricing"
> Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and SLAs"
> Private: "Private deployments with VPC & on-prem options for regulated workloads"
Tom Nguyen: those read clean. Tiny tweak: Hosted replace 'minutes' with 'minutes, not months' — more punch.
Lena Brooks: webinar idea: 'Serving LLMs at scale: cost, latency, and security tradeoffs' — use as content magnet on all three pages via CTA 'Watch the webinar'. We can capture MQLs.
Ava Chen: good. Who can draft a one-pager for each page? Maya — hosted. Ravi — dedicated. Tom — private. Finish drafts by tomorrow noon.
Maya Lopez: I'll do hosted draft + bench callout. Will include 1-sentence customer use case.
Ravi Patel: I'll draft dedicated + callout about autoscaling policies and SLAs. Need product SMEs to confirm numbers.
Tom Nguyen: I'll do private + KMS/HSM bullet. Also add 'audit logs' and 'on-prem option'.
Lena Brooks: ops-bot can you drop the HubSpot snippet for 'lead_route' and forms?
ops-bot: HubSpot snippet: <form hidden_fields="lead_route" /> — deployed to staging forms library.
Ava Chen: Final check — hero, 3 CTAs, benchmark anchor, webinar CTA, and form routing. If no objections I'll merge copy PR at 3pm.
Ravi Patel: approve
Maya Lopez: approve :thumbsup:
Tom Nguyen: approve
Lena Brooks: approve :rocket:
Ava Chen: thanks team — will open PR and ping for quick review.
